The accumulated benefit obligation for the Japanese defined benefit pension plans was $233 million at June 28,
2013. Net actuarial gains for the defined benefit pension plans of $14 million are recognized in accumulated other
comprehensive loss in the consolidated balance sheet as of June 28, 2013. There were no prior service credits for the
defined benefit pension plans recognized in accumulated other comprehensive loss in the consolidated balance sheet as
of June 28, 2013. The amount expected to be amortized into net periodic benefit cost in fiscal 2014 is immaterial to
the consolidated financial statements.

rates. The Company develops the rate of compensation increase assumptions using local compensation practices and
historical rates of increases.
